clips.send: A mom sends this to her sister before grocery day - anxiety over what 'all natural' really hides.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the front of a food label is where the lies live. "All natural" isn't regulated - it means nothing. "Made with organic" can be only 10% organic. Only "100% organic" means what you think it means.

His own shortlist: if soy, corn syrup, hydrogenated oil, canola oil, MSG, or aspartame shows up anywhere on the ingredient list, it goes back on the shelf.

Around 15,000 chemicals can legally skip the label entirely - which is why reading the back, not the front, is the only way to know what's actually in your cart.

How many of those five words are sitting in your pantry right now?

#kevintrudeau #foodlabels #cleaneating #realfood #nongmo #wbdaily

clips.send: A guy sends this to his gym buddy who keeps buying the wrong beef - awe at the fix.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells the story of a friend who spent three weeks in Argentina eating 100% grass-fed beef. He came home and said, "I feel like Superman. I want to pump iron, chase women, and get to the gym." He wasn't on anything - his body was finally making its own testosterone again.

The difference, Kevin says, is CLA: a compound found in beef raised on grass its entire life, not just "grass-fed" marketing that still finishes cows on grain.

It's not a drug. It's a hormone your body already knows how to make.

Next steakhouse trip, are you asking where the beef actually grew up?

#kevintrudeau #grassfedbeef #testosterone #realfood #menshealth #wbdaily

clips.send: A dad sends this to his wife mid-grocery-trip - anger that the 'healthy' oil swap was the lie.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says McDonald's french fries used to taste better for a reason: beef fat, not the canola and soybean oils used today. Those older fats have a high flash point and don't go rancid the way seed oils do under high heat.

His swap for frying at home: beef fat, duck fat, or lard, ideally from grass-fed or organic animals.

The irony he points to: the oils sold to us as "heart-healthy" are the same ones that go rancid in the fryer.

Which oil is actually in your pantry right now?

#kevintrudeau #seedoils #testosterone #cookingoil #realfood #wbdaily

clips.start_words: Your body is the largest organ
clips.send: A guy sends this to his lifting partner who drinks soy protein shakes daily - anxiety, then anger.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's view: soy, especially the genetically modified soy most of the world eats, raises estrogen and lowers testosterone - "soy on steroids," he calls it.

He points to drinking water and plastics as added sources of hormone disruption, on top of soy showing up in protein powders, bars, and processed food fillers.

His advice: check the label before testosterone ever becomes the symptom you're chasing down later.

Do you know how many products in your kitchen list soy as an ingredient?
